plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Coordination protocol for running a fleet of named Claude Code agents in parallel under one human: delegate one mandate at a time (brief), report back on a stop condition (report), hand off state at context limits (relay) — one skill per machine arrow, SendMessage the only transport. No skill reads the protocol at runtime: the mandate carries its own contract, so all three run in windows with no context to spare without reading anything at all, and a window that has never seen the plugin still behaves correctly. Context is under the human's control on both sides: read_first closes what a delegate opens before it starts, deliverable puts its findings on disk so reports and relay packets carry pointers rather than content, and a relay hands its successor the role lines that land it in READY instead of straight back into the work.

plugins.name: ring
plugins.description: Control-plane plugin for tracking rings: recursive units of work, each a problem to settle rather than a session. A ring has a Brief frozen at open, a Trace of local working memory discarded at close, and a Delta typed by effect (ESTABLISHED, INVALIDATED, SURFACED, DELIVERABLE) that crosses exactly one turn to its parent. Ring state is orthogonal to what carries it: the four vehicles are inline, subagent, session and resumed. For vehicle session, ring layers on top of the team plugin as its vehicle — team keeps circulating mandates, reports and relay packets between named agents unchanged, while ring tracks which problem is open, who is carrying it, and what crosses back up. Ships three skills (open, close, rings) for descending into and ascending out of a ring and for listing/graphing the live tree, exclusive create:/writes: write-right tracking with prefix-inclusion collision detection and a lineage exception for parent-child delegation, and a closing sweep that scans disk for files born or touched outside declared claims.
